title: The 8 Best Router Bits for Beginners 2026
h1: The 8 Best Router Bits for Beginners 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for router bits for beginners 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at router bits for beginners 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Freud 91-100 13-Piece Super Bit Set
products.blurb: Key specs: 13 bits, Carbide tipped, 1/4-inch shanks.
strengths: Freud is the professional-grade carbide bit brand -- sharper and longer-lasting than budget sets
Anti-kickback design limits depth-of-cut to prevent dangerous catches
13 bits cover the most common edge profiles and straight cuts
The most commonly recommended starter set by experienced woodworkers
limitations: 1/4-inch shanks only -- most bits need 1/2-inch shank for heavy work
More bits than a true beginner needs -- some may not be used for months
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Freud 12-122 1/2-Inch Double Flute Straight Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: Two-flute straight, 1/2-inch diameter, 1/2-inch shank.
strengths: The most versatile single router bit -- cuts dadoes, rabbets, grooves, and mortises
1/2-inch shank for rigidity -- no bit deflection in deep cuts
Freud carbide is sharper and smoother than budget straight bits
The first individual bit to buy for any router kit
limitations: Single diameter -- may need 3/4-inch and 1/4-inch straight bits as well
Single purpose -- does not profile edges

products.name: Freud 34-116 1/2-Inch Radius Rounding Over Bit (Quadra-Cut)
products.blurb: Key specs: 1/2-inch radius, Bearing guided, 1/2-inch shank.
strengths: Bearing-guided -- follows the edge of the workpiece automatically without a fence
1/2-inch radius roundover is the most common edge profile in furniture work
Freud's Quadra-Cut carbide design produces a cleaner cut with less tearout on cross-grain cuts
The second individual bit every beginner should buy after the straight bit
limitations: Single radius -- need separate bits for 1/4-inch and 1/8-inch roundovers

products.name: Freud 42-114 1/2-Inch Bearing Flush Trim Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: Bearing on tip, Pattern routing, 3/4-inch cut length.
strengths: Bearing on the bit tip allows following a template attached to the bottom of the workpiece
The correct bit for template and pattern routing -- producing identical copies from a master template
3/4-inch cut length handles standard 3/4-inch stock in a single pass
Essential for any production work, chair seat shaping, and curved furniture parts
limitations: More specialized than roundover or straight bits -- less daily use for beginners
Template making is required to use this bit effectively

products.name: Freud 40-114 1-5/8-Inch Chamfer Router Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: 45 degree chamfer, Bearing guided, Clean angled cut.
strengths: 45 degree chamfer is the modern and Arts and Crafts-appropriate alternative to roundover
Bearing guided -- follows the edge without a fence
Freud carbide quality produces sharp, clean chamfer lines without tearout
The correct bit for contemporary and Shaker-style furniture edge treatments
limitations: Fixed 45 degrees -- cannot cut other chamfer angles
Not appropriate for rounded, soft furniture styles

products.name: Freud 30-114 1/2-Inch Radius Cove Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: 1/2-inch cove radius, Bearing guided, Concave profile.
strengths: The concave counterpart to the roundover -- produces a concave rather than convex edge profile
Used in traditional furniture for cove details on legs, rails, and decorative elements
Bearing-guided for accurate fence-free routing
Freud carbide quality for clean, smooth cove cuts
limitations: Specialized for furniture with traditional decorative elements
Less universal than roundover or chamfer bits for modern work

products.name: CMT 815.817.11 V-Grooving Bit, 90-Degree
products.blurb: Key specs: 90 degree V, Sign lettering, Decorative lines.
strengths: V-groove cuts incised lines and letter forms in wood -- for sign work and decorative paneling
CMT produces professional-grade bits with quality carbide and a non-stick orange coating
90-degree angle is the most versatile choice for lettering and decorative veining
Used in CNC routing and handheld router sign work
limitations: Specialized for lettering and decorative incised work
Requires a fence or careful freehand control -- no bearing guide

products.name: Freud 32-504 Rabbeting Bit Set with Interchangeable Bearings
products.blurb: Key specs: Multiple depths with bearing set, 1/2-inch shank, Cuts 1/4 to 7/8 inch rabbets.
strengths: One bit cuts six different rabbet depths by swapping the bearing -- the correct approach for rabbet versatility
1/2-inch shank for rigidity during rabbet cuts in hardwood
Freud carbide produces clean, flat rabbet bottoms without tearout
The correct bit for cabinet backs, drawer bottoms, and glass panel frames
limitations: More expensive than a single fixed-depth rabbet bit
Bearing set adds small parts to track

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
